"""V2-final independent mutant runner for HS-00.02 (mktemp isolated copies only).

Independently re-implements the 24 mutants of final-g-mutants.py plus new ones,
runs the frozen tests against each copy, and records everything under
artifacts/hs0002-20260910/v2-final-adv-mutant-*. The product worktree is never written.
"""

import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = ROOT / "humansearch" / ".venv" / "bin" / "python"
HELPER = "scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
MUT_SH = "scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh"
TEST = "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py"
BOUNDARY = "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002_boundaries.py"
COPY_FILES = [HELPER, MUT_SH, TEST, BOUNDARY, "humansearch/pyproject.toml"]
PREFIX = "v2-final-adv-mutant-"

SUFFIX_BLOCK = (
    "        elif message.startswith(expected):\n"
    "            suffix = message[len(expected):]\n"
    '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n'
    "                return True\n"
)
BOUNDARY_LINE = '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n'
GUARD = '    if not expected.strip() or "\\n" in expected or "\\r" in expected:\n        return False\n'
FAIL_FILTER = '        if not line.startswith("FAIL: "):\n            continue\n'
LEGACY_IF = "            if re.fullmatch(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message):\n"
STRIP_LINE = '        message = line.removeprefix("FAIL: ").removesuffix("\\r")\n'
SH_CALL = '  elif ! python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" "$expect"; then\n'
READ_ERR = '        print(f"cannot read kickoff output: {error}", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n'

MUTANTS: list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = [
    ("m00-normal", HELPER, "", "", "pass"),
    ("m01-always-allow", HELPER, GUARD, "    return True\n" + GUARD, "fail"),
    ("m02-always-reject", HELPER, GUARD, "    return False\n" + GUARD, "fail"),
    ("m03-regex-restore", HELPER, SUFFIX_BLOCK,
     "        elif re.search(expected, message):\n            return True\n", "fail"),
    ("m04-omit-fail-line-filter", HELPER, FAIL_FILTER, "", "fail"),
    ("m05-omit-boundary", HELPER, SUFFIX_BLOCK,
     "        elif message.startswith(expected):\n            return True\n", "fail"),
    ("m06-restore-old-grep", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! /usr/bin/grep -q -- "$expect" "$TMP/out.log"; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m07-accept-empty-expected", HELPER, GUARD,
     '    if "\\n" in expected or "\\r" in expected:\n        return False\n', "fail"),
    ("m08-legacy-substring", HELPER, LEGACY_IF, "            if expected in message:\n", "fail"),
    ("m09-legacy-match-unanchored-end", HELPER, LEGACY_IF,
     "            if re.match(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message):\n", "fail"),
    ("m10-legacy-search", HELPER, LEGACY_IF,
     "            if re.search(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message):\n", "fail"),
    ("m11-boundary-any-non-alnum", HELPER, BOUNDARY_LINE,
     "            if not suffix or not suffix[0].isalnum():\n", "fail"),
    ("m12-substring-anywhere-with-boundary", HELPER, SUFFIX_BLOCK,
     "        elif (idx := message.find(expected)) >= 0:\n"
     "            suffix = message[idx + len(expected):]\n"
     '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n'
     "                return True\n", "fail"),
    ("m13-legacy-target-wildcard", HELPER,
     'TARGET = r"(?:PR #[0-9]+|task/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+)"\n', 'TARGET = r".*"\n', "fail"),
    ("m14-drop-slash-boundary", HELPER, BOUNDARY_LINE,
     '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t":\n', "fail"),
    ("m15-drop-newline-guard", HELPER, GUARD, "    if not expected.strip():\n        return False\n", "fail"),
    ("m16-unreadable-file-exit0", HELPER, READ_ERR, READ_ERR.replace("return 2", "return 0"), "fail"),
    ("m17-shell-inverted", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" "$expect"; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m18-shell-args-swapped", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$expect" "$TMP/out.log"; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m19-shell-unquoted-expect", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" $expect; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m20-exact-full-line-only", HELPER, BOUNDARY_LINE, "            if not suffix:\n", "fail"),
    ("m21-pass-lines-also-count", HELPER, FAIL_FILTER,
     '        if not line.startswith(("FAIL: ", "PASS: ")):\n            continue\n', "fail"),
    ("m22-no-prefix-strip", HELPER, STRIP_LINE, '        message = line.removesuffix("\\r")\n', "fail"),
    ("m23-legacy-table-emptied", HELPER, "LEGACY_REASONS = {\n",
     "LEGACY_REASONS: dict[str, str] = {}\n_UNUSED = {\n", "fail"),
    ("m24-legacy-count-allow-zero", HELPER, "[1-9][0-9]*개가", "[0-9]+개가", "fail"),
    # --- new V2-final mutants ---
    ("n25-strip-expected-before-compare", HELPER, "def has_failure(output: str, expected: str) -> bool:\n",
     "def has_failure(output: str, expected: str) -> bool:\n    expected = expected.strip()\n", "fail"),
    ("n26-guard-only-empty-not-blank", HELPER, GUARD,
     '    if not expected or "\\n" in expected or "\\r" in expected:\n        return False\n', "fail"),
    ("n27-drop-cr-suffix-strip", HELPER, STRIP_LINE, '        message = line.removeprefix("FAIL: ")\n', "fail"),
    ("n28-fail-prefix-without-space", HELPER, FAIL_FILTER,
     '        if not line.startswith("FAIL:"):\n            continue\n', "fail"),
    ("n29-legacy-fallthrough-to-literal", HELPER,
     "        elif message.startswith(expected):\n", "        if message.startswith(expected):\n", "fail"),
    ("n30-legacy-count-allow-one", HELPER, "(?:[2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)개", "[1-9][0-9]*개", "fail"),
    ("n31-boundary-adds-emdash", HELPER, BOUNDARY_LINE,
     '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/\\u2014-":\n', "fail"),
    ("n32-cli-swallow-unicode-error-exit1", HELPER, "    except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:\n",
     "    except OSError as error:\n", "fail"),
    ("n33-cli-mismatch-exit0", HELPER, "    return 0 if has_failure(output, sys.argv[2]) else 1\n",
     "    return 0 if has_failure(output, sys.argv[2]) else 0\n", "fail"),
    ("n34-cli-usage-exit0", HELPER, '        print("usage: has-kickoff-failure.py LOG EXPECTED", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n',
     '        print("usage: has-kickoff-failure.py LOG EXPECTED", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 0\n', "fail"),
    ("n35-split-lines-universal", HELPER, '    for line in output.split("\\n"):\n',
     "    for line in output.splitlines():\n", "fail"),
    ("n36-shell-ignore-helper-rc", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! { python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" "$expect" || true; }; then\n', "fail"),
    ("n37-shell-helper-path-wrong", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure-missing.py "$TMP/out.log" "$expect"; then\n', "fail"),
]


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def clean_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in {"BASH_ENV", "ENV"}}


def apply(iso: Path, rel: str, old: str, new: str, name: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    originals = {f: (ROOT / f).read_text(encoding="utf-8") for f in (HELPER, MUT_SH)}
    for f, text in originals.items():
        (iso / f).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    if not old:
        return "", 0
    applied = originals[rel].count(old)
    assert applied == 1, f"{name}: pattern occurrences = {applied}"
    mutated = originals[rel].replace(old, new)
    (iso / rel).write_text(mutated, encoding="utf-8")
    diff = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(originals[rel].splitlines(keepends=True), mutated.splitlines(keepends=True),
                                        fromfile=f"a/{rel}", tofile=f"b/{rel}"))
    return diff, applied


def run_case(iso: Path, name: str, rel: str, old: str, new: str, expectation: str) -> dict:
    diff, applied = apply(iso, rel, old, new, name)
    (ART / f"{PREFIX}{name}.diff").write_text(diff, encoding="utf-8")
    cmd = [str(PY), "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--rootdir", str(iso / "humansearch"),
           str(iso / TEST), str(iso / BOUNDARY)]
    start = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=iso, env=clean_env(), text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    end = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    out = proc.stdout + ("\n--- stderr ---\n" + proc.stderr if proc.stderr else "")
    (ART / f"{PREFIX}{name}.log").write_text(out, encoding="utf-8")
    summary = [line for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if " passed" in line or " failed" in line]
    failed_nodes = [line for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("FAILED ")]
    real_assert = proc.returncode == 1 and "AssertionError" in out and "ERROR collecting" not in out and "error" not in (summary[-1] if summary else "error")
    status = ("PASS" if proc.returncode == 0 else "FAIL-UNEXPECTED") if expectation == "pass" else ("KILLED" if real_assert else "SURVIVED")
    return {"name": name, "file": rel, "expectation": expectation, "status": status, "pattern_occurrences": applied,
            "command": cmd, "cwd": str(iso), "start": start, "end": end, "exit_code": proc.returncode,
            "summary": summary[-1] if summary else "", "failed_count": len(failed_nodes),
            "failed_nodes": [n.split("::", 1)[-1][:160] for n in failed_nodes],
            "mutated_sha256": sha(iso / rel) if rel else "", "diff_file": f"{PREFIX}{name}.diff", "log_file": f"{PREFIX}{name}.log"}


def main() -> int:
    before = {f: sha(ROOT / f) for f in (HELPER, MUT_SH, TEST, BOUNDARY)}
    iso = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hs0002-v2-final-adv-"))
    for f in COPY_FILES:
        (iso / f).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / f, iso / f)
    only = set(sys.argv[1:])
    results = []
    for name, rel, old, new, expectation in MUTANTS:
        if only and name not in only:
            continue
        r = run_case(iso, name, rel, old, new, expectation)
        print(f"{r['status']:16} {name:40} exit={r['exit_code']} failed={r['failed_count']} {r['summary']}")
        results.append(r)
    after = {f: sha(ROOT / f) for f in (HELPER, MUT_SH, TEST, BOUNDARY)}
    report = {"verifier": "claude-v2-final", "started_head": subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True).stdout.strip(),
              "isolated_copy": str(iso), "product_sha256_before": before, "product_sha256_after": after,
              "product_unchanged": before == after, "results": results,
              "survived": [r["name"] for r in results if r["status"] == "SURVIVED"],
              "unexpected": [r["name"] for r in results if r["status"] == "FAIL-UNEXPECTED"]}
    (ART / "v2-final-adv-mutants.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    shutil.rmtree(iso, ignore_errors=True)
    print("product_unchanged:", before == after, "survived:", report["survived"], "unexpected:", report["unexpected"])
    return int(bool(report["survived"] or report["unexpected"]) or not results or before != after)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
